title: RefundPayment
description: Compensation from checkout: undo the checkout's payment. Refunds it when it succeeded (idempotency key checkout-{checkoutId}-refund), cancels the PaymentIntent when it is not final, otherwise re-publishes the failure. Replies: payments.refunded or payments.payment-failed. Keyed by checkoutId.

reason.description: Why the checkout is being undone.
